messages:
Ajay Patel: Hey team — quick pulse on ORCH-1324 handoff. Customer reports staging can't reach the private registry after applying firewall ACLs. Anyone taken ownership of the egress rule test?
Maria Chen: I'm on it. Seeing 403 from registry when curl from bastion. Probably cert mismatch.
Kevin Liu: tagging @Tess — can you confirm the new CA bundle was deployed to the bastion and the image prober?
Tess Ortega: Not yet. I thought infra would push via image-sync job. On my list for today—will bump priority. ETA 2h.
Ajay Patel: Thanks. We need that before the canary tomorrow morning. Customer expects no rollback.
Maria Chen: Repro steps:
```bash
curl -v https://private-registry.company.internal/v2/_catalog
# TLS error: certificate signed by unknown authority
```
Kevin Liu: Also FYI, ORCH-1324 depends on NET-2019 (egress NAT) and SEC-401 (HSM key import). Are those green?
Tess Ortega: NET-2019 is waiting on netops approval (ticket #NET-778). I pinged them earlier. SEC-401 is complete, keys imported by @eng-bot.
eng-bot: SEC-401: key-import completed at 2025-10-03T14:09:22Z.
Ajay Patel: Can we get someone from NetOps to ack? @Kevin can you escalate?
Kevin Liu: Looping in netops: @NetOps-SRE — need NAT egress rule approved for acct ORCH-staging asap, currently blocking canary.
NetOps-SRE: acknowledged, will review within 1h. Small clarification: need CIDR ranges for the registry—who can provide?
Maria Chen: Registry CIDRs: 10.240.18.0/24, 10.240.19.0/24. I've dropped them in the ticket.
Tess Ortega: Also found that image-sync uses CA at /etc/ssl/redwood/ca.pem — will push config via ansible.
Ajay Patel: Thanks. Two asks to close in this thread:
1) owner for immediate bastion CA push
2) confirm netops approval before 17:00 PT
Kevin Liu: I'll take #1 — will run ansible playbook and message back when done.
Maria Chen: I'll validate the curl and report back with exact error headers.
Tess Ortega: I'll follow the NET-778 ticket and ping for approval.
Ajay Patel: Quick heads-up: CRs touching the airgap script need code review—@Maria can you file the CR and tag @kevin for quick review? We can't merge without SEC signoff.
Maria Chen: Filed CR #6578 — short changes to cert path and prober. Tagging @Kevin.
Kevin Liu: Reviewing now. If green I'll merge and trigger canary. ETA 45m.
NetOps-SRE: NAT egress rule approved in NET-778; canary window cleared for 06:00 PT.
Ajay Patel: Solid. If all good we'll schedule canary 06:00. @Tess please keep rollback plan handy.
Tess Ortega: Will have rollback steps in runbook and pre-signed certs available.
eng-bot: Deploy job orchard-canary started at 2025-10-04T06:00:12Z.
Maria Chen: Smoke results: registry access ok from bastion, images pulled. No TLS errors. :tada:
Kevin Liu: Merged CR #6578. monitor dashboard link: https://console.redwood.internal/dash/ORCH-1324
Ajay Patel: Great work. Closing this thread after post-canary async notes. If anything flares ping here.
